$comment: Copy to calendars.json (gitignored) and fill in real calendar IDs. One entry per Google calendar. `id` = the calendar's address (…@group.calendar.google.com). `category` = the domain name events are logged under (1 calendar = 1 category). `tier` groups categories for the Productive-vs-Waste metric: 'productive' | 'neutral' | 'waste'. Run the Garmin project's list_calendars.py (or Google Calendar settings) to find each id.
